records.d: Eugen Sanger's Silbervogel concept in the 1930s imagined a rocket plane skipping across the atmosphere: the first spaceplane design. The winged spacecraft was drawn before rockets flew. The dream predates the hardware.
records.h: The suborbital bomber concept used atmospheric skipping for range. The design was theoretical. The vision was winged.
records.mj: Established - documented 1930s Sanger-Bredt concept; first spaceplane design.

records.d: The X-15 rocket plane program began flights in 1959: wings to the edge of space. The spaceplane flew as research. The boundary was explored.
records.h: The rocket-powered X-15 flew 199 missions to the edge of space. The data was foundational. The research was winged.
records.mj: Established - documented X-15 program; rocket plane space-edge flights.

records.d: The Dyna-Soar military spaceplane was canceled in 1963 before flying: the first spaceplane program to die. The dream met budgets. The lesson was cost.
records.h: The X-20 was designed for orbital military missions. Cancellation ended the program. The hardware never flew.
records.mj: Established - documented 1963 Dyna-Soar cancellation.

records.d: In 1963, Joseph Walker flew the X-15 to 107.8 km: a winged craft in space. The spaceplane reached space. The altitude record stood.
records.h: Flight 91 exceeded the Karman line. The pilot earned astronaut wings. The winged spacecraft worked.
records.mj: Established - documented 1963 flight; X-15 above 100 km.

records.d: Nixon approved the Space Shuttle in January 1972: the reusable spaceplane as national program. The orbiter would fly again and again. The reusable era began.
records.h: The decision funded a partially reusable winged orbiter. The promise was airline-like operations. The program was historic.
records.mj: Established - documented January 1972 approval; Space Shuttle program.

records.d: Columbia flew STS-1 on April 12, 1981: the first reusable spacecraft to orbit. The orbiter returned. The spaceplane era opened.
records.h: The winged orbiter launched on expendable boosters and landed on a runway. The reuse was partial. The era was real.
records.mj: Established - documented April 12, 1981 flight; first Shuttle mission.

records.d: Challenger was lost on January 28, 1986: the reusable dream's tragedy. The program paused. Safety became the lesson.
records.h: An O-ring failure destroyed the orbiter. The Rogers Commission reformed NASA. The pause was years.
records.mj: Established - documented January 28, 1986 loss; Rogers Commission.

records.d: The Soviet Buran flew uncrewed on November 15, 1988: the automated spaceplane orbited and landed itself. The robot flew the shuttle. The flight was flawless and final.
records.h: The uncrewed orbiter completed two orbits and an automated landing. The program then ended. The demonstration was complete.
records.mj: Established - documented November 15, 1988 flight; uncrewed Buran orbital flight.

records.d: Columbia was lost on February 1, 2003: the second tragedy. The Shuttle's days were numbered. The reusable era's cost was counted.
records.h: Foam strike damage led to breakup on reentry. The CAIB reformed culture. The retirement was scheduled.
records.mj: Established - documented February 1, 2003 loss; Columbia Accident Investigation Board.

records.d: SpaceShipOne won the Ansari X Prize on October 4, 2004: the private spaceplane reached space twice in two weeks. The garage reached space. The prize launched an industry.
records.h: The air-launched rocket plane flew suborbital twice with pilots. The $10M prize was won. The industry was born.
k: Twice to space in two weeks
records.mj: Established - documented October 4, 2004 win; Ansari X Prize.

records.d: The X-37B flew its first mission on April 22, 2010: the robotic military spaceplane. The uncrewed orbiter worked. The spaceplane went autonomous.
records.h: The small robotic spaceplane orbited for 224 days and landed automatically. The missions lengthened. The robot flew.
records.mj: Established - documented April 22, 2010 flight; X-37B first mission.

records.d: The Shuttle retired in July 2011 with Atlantis's landing: the reusable era paused. The orbiters became museums. The lesson was cost.
records.h: STS-135 closed 30 years and 135 missions. The orbiters retired. The pause was strategic.
records.mj: Established - documented July 2011 retirement; end of Shuttle program.

records.d: Dream Chaser development advanced in 2012: the lifting-body commercial spaceplane. The shuttle's successor took shape. The design was NASA-born.
records.h: The lifting-body vehicle promised runway landings for crew and cargo. The heritage was HL-20. The successor was commercial.
records.mj: Established - documented Dream Chaser development; lifting-body commercial spaceplane.

records.d: Reaction Engines advanced SABRE in 2015: the air-breathing rocket engine for Skylon. The single-stage spaceplane had an engine. The physics was tested.
records.h: Precooler tests validated the key technology. The engine breathed air then rocketed. The concept was engineered.
records.mj: Established - documented SABRE precooler tests; air-breathing rocket engine.

records.d: Virgin Galactic's powered test flights in 2018 pushed SpaceShipTwo toward space: the commercial spaceline tested. The tickets were sold. The tests advanced.
records.h: VSS Unity flew powered tests from Mojave. The program progressed. The spaceline neared.
records.mj: Established - documented 2018 powered tests; SpaceShipTwo program.

records.d: The X-37B's sixth mission set duration records in 2020: the robot spaceplane stayed years. The endurance was proven. The missions were routine.
records.h: OTV-6 orbited over 900 days. The operations were mature. The robot was reliable.
records.mj: Established - documented long-duration X-37B missions; robotic spaceplane endurance.

records.d: Richard Branson flew on July 11, 2021: the spaceline's founder in space. The ticket was used. The industry had its moment.
records.h: VSS Unity carried Branson suborbital. The flight was commercial. The moment was symbolic.
records.mj: Established - documented July 11, 2021 flight; Branson suborbital.

records.d: Dream Chaser Tenacity construction advanced in 2022: the spaceplane took physical form. The vehicle was real. The cargo missions neared.
records.h: The first orbital vehicle assembled for ISS cargo missions. The hardware was tangible. The missions were scheduled.
records.mj: Emerging - real hardware; Dream Chaser Tenacity construction.

records.d: Sierra Space advanced in 2023: Dream Chaser testing and the LIFE habitat. The spaceplane company grew. The program was funded.
records.h: Environmental testing prepared Tenacity for flight. The company expanded. The funding was real.
records.mj: Emerging - real program; Sierra Space Dream Chaser progress.

records.d: Tenacity completed assembly and testing phases in 2024: the spaceplane ready for its ride. The vehicle waited for launch. The cargo era neared.
records.h: Thermal vacuum and acoustic tests qualified the vehicle. The readiness was high. The launch was pending.
records.mj: Emerging - real milestones; Dream Chaser Tenacity test completion.

records.d: Stoke Space tested reusable second-stage tech in 2024: the fully reusable rocket with spaceplane-like return. The upper stage would land. Reusability went full.
records.h: Hop tests validated the reusable upper stage design. The architecture was novel. The landing was the goal.
records.mj: Emerging - real tests; Stoke Space reusable upper stage.

records.d: By 2025, spaceplane flight tests were advancing across programs: Dream Chaser, Stoke, and others. The runway landings neared. The winged return was coming.
records.h: Multiple programs approached flight. The tests were critical. The landings would be winged.
records.mj: Emerging - real programs; 2025 spaceplane flight test campaigns.

records.d: Radian Aerospace advanced its single-stage spaceplane concept in 2025: the SSTO dream persisted. The sled-launched winged vehicle aimed at orbit. The hardest goal endured.
records.h: The Radian One concept used sled launch and wings for single-stage flight. The physics was demanding. The dream was old.
records.mj: Emerging - real company; Radian single-stage spaceplane concept.
